## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -13.92%) BELOW TREND show complacency while HYG/LQD flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↑ — mixed signals confirm NEUTRAL.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress flagged higher: HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.86%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY with HYG/LQD signal CREDIT STRESS ↑. Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -13.92%) BELOW TREND showing complacency.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -0.34%) RECOVERY leave SPY_TLT effectively flat, while Dollar strength is ↑ rising (Level 27.28, 1W: +0.44% | 1M: +1.08%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Materials leading: XLB (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +10.24%) ABOVE TREND and miners/metals SLV (1W: +11.80% | 1M: +37.74%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials/XBI also showing strength: XBI (1W: +3.15% | 1M: +1.88%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY while Financials XLF (1W: -1.50% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION — Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US holding up: SPY (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND; EM and China catching up: EEM (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +6.58%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.78% | 1M: +5.09%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation intact but uneven: IWM (1W: +3.47% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY signal healthy risk-on in small caps, while IBIT (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND shows crypto weakness.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals leadership: GLD (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.80% | 1M: +37.74%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals CPER (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +11.52%) ABOVE TREND — reflation/inventory bid evident in base and precious metals.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +1.20%) CORRECTION while oil proxy BNO (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -21.60%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (7/11) and SPY/IWM both ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across core ETFs (XLK RECOVERY, XLF CORRECTION, TLT RECOVERY) — this MAJOR Divergence supports a Neutral/Transitional stance.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor materials and metal exposures showing strength (XLB (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +10.24%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +11.80% | 1M: +37.74%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to rate-sensitive/credit watch areas and monitor XLF (1W: -1.50% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION and HYG/LQD signals; bonds neutral: TLT (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -0.34%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials/Miners — XLB (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +10.24%) ABOVE TREND if metals keep outperforming. BEARISH: Financials — XLF (1W: -1.50% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION if credit signals worsen.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver/gold — SLV (1W: +11.80% | 1M: +37.74%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND on continued safe-haven/real yield moves. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -21.60%) BELOW TREND until seasonal support.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~25 (complacency threshold; VXX (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -13.92%) BELOW TREND), Credit Spread ~0.73 (current 0.7333, 1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.78%) watch for widening, SPY_TLT 7.93 (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.37%) as neutral pivot, Breadth 7/11 (watch expansion/contraction).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, VXX complacent but HYG/LQD flagged for rising credit stress, producing mixed confirmations. Materials and precious metals showing strength while Tech/Financials divergence is the key risk to monitor.
